description: This is a PHPUnit test class for testing the LDAPSyncService within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It contains setup routines for LDAP server configuration, multiple test methods to verify LDAP entries fetching, user creation, and handling of special characters in LDAP users.
external_files: OrangeHRM core and LDAP service classes

classes.name: LDAPSyncServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for validating LDAP synchronization functionalities in OrangeHRM, including LDAP entry fetching, user creation, handling special characters, and integration with LDAP server settings.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Static setup to configure LDAP server and skip tests if not configured.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares environment before each test, including server configuration loading and data cleanup.

methods.name: configureServerAndLoadData
methods.description: Mocks LDAP configuration, binds to LDAP, and loads fixture data into LDAP server for testing.

methods.name: testFetchEntryCollections
methods.description: Tests fetching LDAP entries with specific base and scope settings.

methods.name: testFetchEntryCollectionsWithOneLevelLookupEmptyBase
methods.description: Tests retrieving entries with one-level scope and empty base results.

methods.name: testFetchEntryCollectionsWithOneLevelLookup
methods.description: Tests LDAP entry fetching with one-level scope and specific base.

methods.name: testFetchEntryCollectionsWithMultipleLookups
methods.description: Tests fetching entries with multiple lookup bases and configurations.

methods.name: testFetchEntryCollectionsBindAnon
methods.description: Tests LDAP fetching behavior when anonymously binding.

methods.name: testFetchAllLDAPUsers
methods.description: Fetches all LDAP users and verifies the collection including serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: testFetchAllLDAPUsersWithSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Tests LDAP user fetching with special characters in usernames and verifies correct parsing and DN formation.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsers
methods.description: Tests creating internal system users from LDAP entries and verifies database counts.
